title: 第23章 让他画符还不如让他去生崽子第24章 刚死而复生就被当牛使
slug: 玄幻穿成野狗生崽就能变强
lines: 林野心中唾弃了一番秃驴们的缺德。
“所以你还记得多少，被关了多久？真的是百年？”
黑气的轮廓又收缩了一下。
“不知道，时间在这里面没有意义。”
“我只记得禅教，记得被抽干骨髓的感觉。其余的……全是空白。”
林野盯着那团黑气看。
“人族修仙者，偷孩子炼血珠，剥妖兽封魂魄。烂的花样倒是越来越多。”
黑气剧烈震荡了一下，声音忽然变调。
“你的血脉……您是吞日星君的转世？还是星君的子孙？”
林野楞了一下。
他只不过觉醒了百分之五都不到，这玩意竟然能查探出来？
“算是后人吧，你怎么知道的？我一直藏着呢。”
黑气没回答，它的轮廓开始加剥落，飘散在石室的空气中。
“我被封太久，神魂已经碎得拼不回来，大限到了。”
“你的神通让我清醒了片刻，但也仅此而已。”
“我不知道具体的事情了。但我知道你血脉里的东西，是我很久很久以前见过的。”
“我已经没有什么能留下的了，但你变强之后，可以顺着我消散的痕迹走。”
黑气说话间，已经凝成拳头大小的一团，残影在石室中央缓缓升起。
它的最后一缕朝林野飘来，气息融入妖丹，一股浓烈的力量炸开，
【叮！检测到未知强者残魂馈赠！】
【宿主获得：道行+50年！】
【吞日星君血脉觉醒进度：5%！】
黑气彻底散了。
林野抬起头。
那缕残魂消散的方向，穿透石壁，指向黑龙山脉最深处。
林野的吞日星君血脉增幅不大，但经脉里翻涌的力量比刚才猛了。
他拨开地上的碎骨堆，发现了石面上的一道裂痕，里面嵌着块晶石。
林野蹲下来，鼻尖凑上去，感受到一种从内往外渗的寒意。
晶石通体透明，里面有一缕光在缓缓游动。
林野的脑子里炸开一声提示。
【叮！检测到宿主获得特殊物品，混元碎片！】
【混元碎片：诞生于天地初开之前，先天之物。功能未知。】
【该碎片与宿主存在高度共振，建议尝试融合。】
林野犹豫了一息，妖力裹住碎片，往妖丹里送。
content_en:
Lin Yimei scorned the bad behavior of the bald donkeys.
"So how much do you remember and how long you were imprisoned? Is it really a hundred years?"
The outline of the black energy shrank again.
"I don't know, time has no meaning here."
"I only remember Zen teaching and the feeling of being drained of bone marrow. The rest...are all blank."
Lin Ye stared at the black gas.
"Human cultivators steal children to refine blood beads, and skin monsters and beasts to seal their souls. There are more and more bad tricks."
The black energy vibrated violently, and the voice suddenly changed its tone.
"Your bloodline... are you the reincarnation of Sun-Swallowing Star Lord? Or are you a descendant of Star Lord?"
Lin Ye was stunned for a moment.
He is only less than 5% awakened, but this thing can actually detect it?
"It's a descendant, how do you know? I've been hiding it."
The black air didn't answer. Its outline began to peel off, floating in the air of the stone room.
"I have been sealed for too long, and my soul has been too broken to be restored. The time has come."
"Your magical power kept me awake for a moment, but that was all."
"I don't know the specific things. But I know that the things in your bloodline are things I saw a long, long time ago."
"I have nothing left behind, but after you become stronger, you can follow the traces of my dissipation."
While the black energy was speaking, it had condensed into a ball the size of a fist, and its afterimage slowly rose in the center of the stone chamber.
Its last wisp floated toward the forest, its breath blended into the demon pill, and a strong force exploded,
[Ding! A gift from the remnant soul of an unknown powerful person was detected! 】
[The host obtains: Taoism + 50 years! 】
[Sun-Swallowing Star Lord Bloodline Awakening Progress: 5%! 】
The black energy completely dissipated.
Lin Ye raised his head.
The direction in which the remaining soul dissipated penetrated the stone wall and pointed to the deepest part of the Black Dragon Mountain Range.
Linye's Sun-Eating Star Lord's bloodline did not increase much, but the power surging in his meridians was stronger than before.
He pushed aside the pile of broken bones on the ground and found a crack on the stone surface with a crystal embedded in it.
Lin Ye squatted down and brought the tip of his nose up, feeling a chill seeping from the inside out.
The crystal is completely transparent, with a ray of light swimming slowly inside.
A reminder exploded in Lin Ye's mind.
【bite! The host is detected to obtain special items, fragments of Hunyuan! 】
[Hunyuan Fragments: Born before the beginning of the world, they are innate things. Function unknown. 】
[This fragment has a high resonance with the host. It is recommended to try to fuse it. 】
Lin Ye hesitated for a moment, then the demonic power wrapped around the fragments and sent them to the demonic elixir.
title_en: Chapter 23: Let him draw talismans, it is better to let him give birth to babies Chapter 24: He was treated like a cow just after he came back from the dead
